worldcombat.skill.mistyterrain.summary: Lay a veil of mist over the chosen ground: bodies on it cannot be given status conditions and take half damage from Dragon moves. In purifying form it also washes off conditions already carried. It treats both sides alike.
worldcombat.skill.mistyterrain.use.0: Keep the team from being statused
worldcombat.skill.mistyterrain.use.2: Cleanse a poisoned, burned or paralysed ally
worldcombat.skill.mistyterrain.descripti: Lays mist of radius %1$s blocks, lasting %2$s.
A body on the field cannot be given status conditions and takes Dragon move damage multiplied by %1$s.
Protection lingers for %1$s after leaving the mist.
Starts up in %1$s and settles in %2$s, both driven by Speed.
worldcombat.skill.mistyterrain.form.0: Purifying mist: smaller (radius x0.85) and longer (x1.2), washing existing harmful status effects off any body that enters or stays, at the cost of +3 ticks start-up and x1.2 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.mistyterrain.form.1: Veil: wider (radius x1.25) with -2 ticks start-up and x0.9 cooldown, blocking only new conditions and not clearing existing ones, with x0.8 life.
worldcombat.skill.mistyterrain.timing: Cast at ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to lay the mist, recovers %3$s, and commits a %5$s cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.mistyterrain.growth.0: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.mistyterrain.growth.1: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.mistyterrain.preferenc: On = purifying: radius x0.85, life x1.2, existing harmful status effects washed off any body that enters or stays, at the cost of +3 ticks start-up and x1.2 cooldown. Off = veil: radius x1.25, -2 ticks start-up, x0.9 cooldown, x0.8 life, blocking only new conditions and not clearing existing ones.
The companion lays the mist only while a threat is within this distance; lower lays it up close, higher sets it up in advance.
Push the mist at the foe
On, the mist is pressed between you and the threat to screen the fighting line. Off, it is pressed at your feet to shield yourself first.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to lay the mist.
